podcast.title: Artist in 2010s Psych Resurgence
podcast.body: Unknown Mortal Orchestra was mentioned as one of the artists contributing to the resurgence of Psychedelic or Psych Rock in the 2010s. This genre, which was born in the 1960s and fell out of favor in the 70s, saw a significant comeback during the decade. "We saw artists like Ariel Pink, King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard, Temples, the Black Angels, Unknown Mortal Orchestra, Animal Collective, War on Drugs, and Mac DeMarco."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 4: The Revivals

podcast.title: Engaging Live Performances
podcast.body: Anónima Morta Loquorquesta is highly regarded for their live shows, especially at festivals, where they are effective at energizing and engaging large crowds. "suelen dar muy buenos conciertos hecho cuando van a los festivales suelen como mover mucha la gente."
